Always love visiting you guys
Eric has been grooming my dogs for years.  He’s great!  I would highly recommend Petco Grooming.
My pet was quickly bathed and groomed, with tooth brushing and nail trimming in record time. Christine was amazing! She even booked our next appointment!
Eric always does a great job with our doodle!

We have a large senior dog who has severe arthritis and is in her final months.. Eric was wonderful with her. Not only did he give her a great quality cut but he was very compassionate and conscientious.
I have an old crusty dachshund and she came back looking and smelling fabulous! Thank you for your services
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Christina always does a fabulous job and is so patient with my little Polly!

All my previous experiences with grooming were great. I understand that a Chinese Crested dog is not very common, but I do show pictures of what they are supposed to look like. I had taken three other dogs to this location and the results were always great. This last time I was very disappointed. It was a groomer I did not deal with before. I spoke with the groomer in detail and showed her many pictures of what I wanted my pet to look like. I also specifically told her that she needed to take off all the hair on my dog's ears in order to help them stand up, as well as it is a nicer look. I spent over $100 on this that I had to scrape up. My Bella came back with her ears untouched, not trimmed at all, uneven body trim, a couple of matts that I had to comb off, and a bow to hide the uneven hair on the top of her head. I do not think she was groomed at all above her face. I was concerned when I spoke with the groomer and noticed she did not take notes. Also, in the past, when I have picked up my dogs from the groomer, the actual groomer came out to talk to me. This time the groomer did not even look up or wave. She is not the same groomer that took care of Bella the last time. As a regular customer for many years I am super disappointed. This Petco is far from where I live and I may consider switching to a closer location as a result of this disappointment.
We love taking our dogs to Petco’s grooming.  Excellent service. We’ve been taking our dogs since 2018.
Eric is really great with our dog Winnie. She is a very nervous 80lb Saint Bernard rescue pup and he is very patient and caring with her. She looks and smells beautiful again. ❤️

Eric has groomed our two dogs and did a beautiful job. They both look well- maintained  but not “scalped”. One of them had several deep mats when she arrived, but now she looks clean and fresh, mat-free. We are very pleased with Eric’s work.
Great customer service, easy to trust my dog will get treated with love and respect.

We've taken our two dogs to a few other groomers in the last four years but the groomers at Petco (Ashley) gets it right every time. She is attentive and my pups love her! They always come out right the first time. Other places just don't listen and we end up having to return for a re-do or worse yet, we just flat out never go back.

We're super happy we have a place to take our dogs now for everything from a nail clipping to a full-on wash and cut.
Sent him in for a Christmas bath and furminator treatment to combat shedding. He came out looking so shiny and his coat was fluffy and so soft.
Petco on Sports Arena Point Loma has great groomers!! Another great experience, thank you
Great haircut for both Orla and Rory, thank you
Pepper had a really well done groom yesterday. I appreciate it as well as the prompt service.
I live in lemon grove and I drive my baby all the way to pt loma petco because they care thank you 😊 🙏 …
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We value your feedback and apologize if we didn’t meet your expectations.

Petco Grooming off Sports Arena Blvd was absolutely the best! Liz, the groomer, treated my dog Queen with so much care and patience. She gave her the best wash and a much-needed haircut — Queen came out looking adorable and so happy! You can really tell Liz loves what she does. Highly recommend Liz and this Petco location for anyone who wants their pet treated with love and professionalism!
Brought my dog in for a nail trim and buffing. The appointment went seamlessly. I go there regularly, and I recommend them highly.
Easy, friendly and they did a great job with our puppy.
Petco did a great job washing and cleaning our dog. Nice service, friendly people, and our dog looked and smelled great after. I’ll be going back when down here!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Overall a good grooming, however my dog was still wet when i picked her up.

When I booked for July and August the rate was 65 and in September it was 70. Then when i went in July they charged the 70 rate as well in August. This doesn't seem legal and disappointed in the continuous $5 increases that happen very often plus the 5.99 for materials. How do you groom without them? Seems like corporate greed to me especially at this time with people struggling to keep their pets. I appreciate my groomer.

This location is my home store because my first few experiences at this location made me want to come back due to their excellent service and care to my animal.
I’ve learned over the course of time that some groomers have excellent expertise and skill taking care of the animals and fulfilling the services whereas some groomers do okay.
I have my favorite groomers I tend to gravitate towards to and some I don’t want to revisit.
I do believe first impressions really matter definitely when it comes to care of my furry animal.

The groomers know my pets and they are kind and attentive to my family members.  I was late and they were so gracious to accommodate my tardiness.  Overall they do an awesome job.  Yes. I would recommend them.

So thankful a friend recommended Kristina S! We have gone to her about 4 times over the last couple of months and each time she makes sure me and Benny are both comfortable before starting the grooming process. Benny is a 8 month mini bernedoodle and can be shy and anxious and she still somehow manages to handle it with ease. Even though there is another petco down the street from me we will keep coming back to see Miss Kristina!
We're thrilled to see that you gave us a high rating! Your support means a lot to us, and we're glad we could provide you with a positive experience.

The young man taking care of my dog could not handle her, nor perform the procedure that I requested.  He told me I could not bring her back, to go elsewhere.  Funny thing...the women grommers don't seem to have a problem, and can perform the procedure.  We have been here once a month for 10 months since I adopted her, no problems.
My dogs were groomed at Petco.  I have been grooming them there for the past 8 months and have always been satisfied.  The groomer who helped me was:
Caring, fast and supportive.

I’m ashamed to say that I hadn’t taken my dog to groom because I didn’t have enough money but I was able to yesterday!  My dog came in stinky and Liliana was able to make him smell AWESOME again!! (By the way I’ve tried bathing my Malamute by myself before and I guess I’m just too old for that now as my back went out the one time I tried)

Lisa is the best and definitely worth waiting for to get an appointment. She always goes above and beyond. We are happy with the service she provides for our dogs and will see her for the next foreseeable years.

With my dog being highly emotional during grooming, they did what they could do and I’m very satisfied with the outcome and pricing. Even though they could not complete the entire haircut, due to my dog being an a hole during grooming, they did a wonderful job. I’d like to come back if my dog can calm down! Thanks for making dreams come true!

Paid $94 for a haircut for my 40lb Aussie. The groomer was friendly but she left the fur between my dog’s toes untrimmed, which is a large reason why I like him to get a haircut. I was also asked to pay and even give a tip when I picked him up before even seeing him which didn’t feel right.

Probably would pay a little more for a more professional groomer somewhere else next time.
Hi Jhon23 Home Work Out. We're delighted to receive your complimentary review. Your satisfaction is important to us!
Very caring and patient when grooming my little dog Leleu
My cute lil fur baby looked all cute and groomed all thanks to Jaime! She was extremely patient and did a great job explaining how she intended to groom him.
Prices are too high!!
